title: PromptCompilerContract
description: Contract for late-stage, model-aware prompt compilation and dynamic negative prompt formulation at render execution time.

positive_prompt.description: The final model-adapted kinetic or visual prompt adhering to the target model's character and token budget.

negative_prompt.description: Genre-calibrated and model-tailored negative prompt avoiding contradictory photographic or stylistic penalties.

character_count.description: Character count of the compiled positive prompt.

token_budget_safe.description: True if the prompt fits within safe_char_limit without unsafe hard clipping.

is_kinetic_filtered.description: True if static attire and environment details were filtered out for I2V modality.

audio_markup_applied.description: True if model-specific speech or dialogue tags (<d> or Spoken line:) were injected.
